products.name: SCOT (Space Camera for Object Tracking)
products.description: India's first homegrown space surveillance satellite; enables space-to-space observation; launched Jan 14, 2025 on SpaceX Transporter-12; sun-synchronous orbit

products.name: ALBATROSS
products.description: Planned missile detection satellite line; part of Digantara's expansion into missile warning and tracking

products.name: SKYGATE
products.description: Network of ground-based sensors for situational awareness; complements space-based surveillance

products.name: AIRA
products.description: Integrated infrastructure for connecting space and ground components

products.name: MOSAIC (AI-powered Wide Area Sensing Architecture)
products.description: AI-powered optical sensor network for real-time tracking of objects in LEO; 5 interconnected sensor nodes; uses 'Lost-in-Space' attitude estimation; designed for harsh environments; deployed Aug 2026 after Op Sindoor

people.name: Anirudh Sharma
people.title: Co-founder and Chief Executive Officer
people.prior_role: Computer Science undergrad at Lovely Professional University (2016-2020); participated in ISRO student satellite program

people.education: Lovely Professional University (B.Tech CS); incubated at IISc SID

people.name: Rahul Rawat
people.title: Co-founder and Chief Operating Officer
people.prior_role: LPU alumnus; co-founded Digantara from dormitory
people.background: Co-founded Digantara with Anirudh Sharma in 2018; Forbes India profile notes non-aerospace educational background

people.name: Tanveer Ahmed
people.title: Co-founder and Chief Technology Officer
people.prior_role: Participated in ISRO's student satellite program; developed payloads for university satellite team
people.background: Schoolmate of Anirudh Sharma; co-founded Digantara; spearheads design and development of core SSA capabilities
